links.outcome: Independent validation of pancreatic cancer model; specificity across other cancer outcomes
links.effect: Model was independently validated in a 2.3 million patient cohort, but its scores were also correlated with ovarian cancer, suggesting conflation of outcomes due to confounders.
links.quote: While we were able to independently validate the pancreatic cancer prediction model, we found that its prediction scores were also correlated with ovarian cancer, suggesting conflation of outcomes due to underlying confounders.

unlisted_practices: Using a multi-class multi-outcome model architecture instead of single-outcome prediction models to improve specificity and mitigate outcome conflation

screen.reason: The study empirically tests a method (multi-class model architecture) to mitigate outcome conflation/false-positive specificity issues caused by confounders in EHR-based disease risk prediction.

primary.practice: multi-class vs single-outcome architecture to mitigate outcome conflation
